newsitem.title: USA: Dominican utility sale to start by end-97 - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Dominican utility sale to start by end-97 - Salomon.

text.p: The privatization of the Dominican Republic's electric sector should start by the end of 1997, Salomon Brothers said Tuesday.

Salomon Brothers, financial adviser to Corporacion Dominicana de Electricidad, said in a statement that plans for restructuring the electric sector included breaking up the company into three distribution companies, three generation companies, a transmission company and a services company.

"Salomon Brothers expects that the sale of the three distribution companies and the award of the transmission contract will occur by year-end 1997, with the generator sales to follow soon after," the statement said.

The utility held a meeting July 10 in Santo Domingo, capital of the Caribbean nation, to present its sale plans. It was attended by representatives from 21 international electric companies based in the United States, Europe and Latin America.
The electricity sector in the Dominican Republic has about 1,400 megawatts of generation serving two million customers.
